events.what_it_is: An eleven-day public Walmart fashion pop-up featuring Free Assembly, Scoop, Avia and Scenario, plus beauty discovery.
events.what_is_free: Free admission to browse the pop-up. The official Walmart page advertises fashion and beauty discovery but does not promise a specific take-home giveaway.
events.caveats: The official page confirms daily hours and public shopping access. Merchandise is for sale; no guaranteed free item is advertised.
events.practical_notes: Open daily September 10–20 from 11 AM–7 PM.

events.event_name: FDLA × United Palace: The Life of Giannina Azar
events.brand: Fashion Designers of Latin America × United Palace
events.address: United Palace, 4140 Broadway, New York, NY 10033
events.what_it_is: An immersive runway showcase by Giannina Azar with a live performance by Maria Del Sol at United Palace.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary admission with RSVP is explicitly offered by United Palace.
events.caveats: RSVP is required for complimentary admission. United Palace says additional tickets will be released in September, so availability can change.
events.practical_notes: Doors are at 6 PM and the show is at 7 PM. Reserve through the United Palace ticket page.

events.event_name: Fenty Beauty Shade Match IRL — Ulta Upper East Side
events.address: Ulta Beauty, 188 E 86th St, New York, NY 10028
events.what_it_is: A Fenty Beauty in-store shade-matching activation for Pro Filt’r Fluid Flex Foundation.
events.what_is_free: Shade matching plus advertised freebies, goodies and giveaways; exact quantities are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: The official Fenty page confirms this Ulta location for September 11. Freebies and giveaway inventory are not guaranteed to every visitor.
events.practical_notes: No RSVP requirement is published on the official event locator.

events.event_name: Fenty Beauty Shade Match IRL — Sephora 34th Street
events.address: Sephora 34th Street, 112 W 34th St, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: A Fenty Beauty in-store shade-matching activation for Pro Filt’r Fluid Flex Foundation.
events.what_is_free: Shade matching plus advertised freebies, goodies and giveaways; exact quantities are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: The supplied roundup incorrectly labels the September 12–13 Midtown stop as Ulta at 51 W 34th St. Fenty's official locator instead lists Sephora at 112 W 34th St for September 12 and 13, so the official location is used.
events.practical_notes: Use the official Fenty location rather than the roundup address.

events.what_it_is: A first-come beauty activation where guests play Lipstick Roulette and receive a randomly selected shade while supplies last.
events.what_is_free: The first 500 guests receive a lip & PROTECT SPF 60+ lipstick and can use the event video booth.
events.caveats: First come, first served and while supplies last. A secondary roundup incorrectly shows an 8 PM close; current brand marketing and another live listing support 11 AM–5 PM, which is used here.
events.practical_notes: Arrive early if the free lipstick matters; only the first 500 are promised one.

events.what_it_is: OSEA's 30th-anniversary Malibu Market pop-up with skincare sampling, community activations and treats.
events.what_is_free: Every attendee is advertised to receive Undaria Algae Body Oil samples while supplies last; the first 50 receive a custom mini OSEA tote. Sharing the Malibu Market on social unlocks a deluxe oil and custom keychain while supplies last.
events.caveats: Open to the public with no tickets required. Tote bags and other items are quantity-limited; all giveaway language is while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Arrive near opening for the first-50 tote; samples are advertised more broadly but still subject to inventory.

events.address: The Penthouse, The Standard East Village, 25 Cooper Sq, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A public NYFW showroom of independent designers with shopping, founder meet-and-greets and networking on The Standard's 21st floor.
events.what_is_free: Free admission with RSVP to browse the showroom and meet participating designers; merchandise is for sale.
events.caveats: RSVP is required. The Standard's page provides an RSVP action, but a standalone public registration URL was not reliably exposed in search results.
events.practical_notes: Use The Standard's official event page to RSVP before going.

events.event_name: NET-A-PORTER Private Shopping Event with Gloria Nakash
events.what_it_is: A one-day private shopping event to discover stylist Gloria Nakash's edit of NET-A-PORTER fall collections.
events.what_is_free: Access to the private shopping event is not advertised with a ticket price; merchandise is for sale.
events.caveats: RSVP is required by email to glorianakash@gmail.com, and the address is only provided after confirmation. This is private shopping access, not a walk-in public pop-up.
events.practical_notes: Email the RSVP address and wait for confirmation before planning around it.

occurrences.details: First 500 guests receive a free lipstick while supplies last.
First 50 receive the mini tote; samples advertised for all attendees while supplies last.
Address provided only after RSVP confirmation.
